meta.name: toc
meta.description: Regenerate, validate, or compute kramdown slugs for markdown TOCs. Same rules as idvorkin/markdown-toc.nvim (`:Mtoc update`) so this tool and the nvim plugin produce identical output. Use when asked to update a TOC, fix a broken deep link, check for duplicate section headings, or compute an anchor slug for a heading. Works on any markdown file in the blog — not just `_d/changelog.md`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成、校验或修复 Markdown 目录锚点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常写 Markdown 文档并需要维护目录和锚点链接
copy.tagline_en: Regenerate, validate, or fix markdown TOC anchors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write Markdown docs and need to maintain TOCs and anchor links

howto.what: Claude 可以重新生成、验证或计算 Markdown 文件的目录（TOC），修复失效的锚点链接，检查重复的章节标题，并生成 kramdown 风格的锚点 slug。
howto.when: 当你要求更新 TOC、修复失效的深层链接、检查重复标题，或计算某个标题的锚点 slug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我更新这篇博客的目录。
say.note: Claude 会重新生成 TOC 并替换原有内容。

say.text: 检查一下这个文件里有没有重复的标题。
say.note: Claude 会验证并报告重复的标题。

say.text: 计算标题“AI & Machine Learning”的锚点 slug。
say.note: Claude 会输出对应的 slug。

howto.what_en: Claude can regenerate, validate, or compute kramdown slugs for markdown TOCs, fix broken deep links, check for duplicate section headings, and compute anchor slugs for headings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to update a TOC, fix a broken deep link, check for duplicate headings, or compute an anchor slug for a heading.

say_en.text: Update the TOC for this blog post.
say_en.note: Claude regenerates the TOC and replaces the existing one.

say_en.text: Check this file for duplicate headings.
Compute the slug for "AI & Machine Learning".
